reviews.text: Unfortunately, it wasn't a good experience, especially not for my cat.

Highly competent professionals.

They treated my dog ​​very well.

In 2020, my cat underwent castration surgery at this clinic. One of his testicles was impacted, and I was assured it had been removed during the procedure.

In the last year, my cat began exhibiting strange and aggressive behavior. We looked for several possible causes: we had tests, analyses, medication, and even behavioral counseling, all without results.

Recently, we decided to investigate the possibility of any remaining testicular tissue. To our surprise, it was confirmed that it was not tissue residue—the impacted testicle was never removed.

In other words, we paid for surgery that supposedly solved the problem, when in reality the testicle was still present. This forced us to endure months of worry, unnecessary tests, and expenses.

I consider this situation very serious and a complete breach of trust.
An extremely pleasant and attentive person, always ready to help, and obviously an extraordinary professional. Thank you for everything, Dr. Mário, and see you soon! 🖤🖤🖤 …

I have a cat who, at 2 years old, started losing weight and wasting away day by day. After consulting several veterinarians, without any solution and in desperation, I managed to get an appointment with Dr. Mário, who diagnosed kidney disease.
Since then, my cat has never seen another veterinarian. Today she is 14 years old and continues to be wonderful, thanks to the care provided by Dr. Mário.
Now I have a small kitten who is obviously also followed by Dr. Mário.
I recommend him without any doubt, for his professionalism, dedication and all the affection he dedicates to us.
Well done, Dr. Mário Santos

My dog ​​was neutered by this veterinarian on July 14, 2025. He came home bleeding, which is not normal. 48 hours later, my dog ​​died in the Porto hospital with his lungs full of blood. I have reports from two hospitals. This veterinarian says he didn't intubate the dog, yet another case of negligence.
I hope to find out who is responsible; my poodle was 1 year old. And the pain is inexplicable.
I would like a veterinarian to speak up, because they say things but don't write them down.
This is a diaper rash from the bleeding 48 hours later.
Excellent professionals, with a great love for animals!!

A sensational person... I have nothing to post because I am grateful from the bottom of my heart. For saving my girl... I recommend D's clinic. Mario Santos, because through work, dedication, and love for animals, deserves it. All our respect 🥰👏👏👏👏 …

Dr. Mario Santos, a veterinarian par excellence.
For his kindness, love, and dedication to our animals, thank you to the Doctor and his entire team.
Keep your animals away from this place.
